description.en: Generic geological teaching reconstruction, not a specific measured locality specimen or a literal thin section enlarged into a mound. First-party UGS external mound and microscopic/core fabric support distinct exterior and internal clotted fabric. Teaching cut pattern deliberately enlarged and simplified; macroscopic appearance alone does not establish microbial species or precise biological process. Dimensions/palette/clot pattern artistic.
